title: Removal of the Main Landing Gear Leg Assembly

ata.title: Main Gear — Main Gear Leg Assembly

abstract: Removal of one main landing gear leg assembly from the aircraft with the gear bay supported, covering the depressurisation of the shock absorber, the disconnection sequence and the handling of the leg on its trolley.

sections.purpose: This task removes one main landing gear leg assembly from the aircraft so that it can be sent for overhaul or exchanged, and leaves the gear bay in a condition that allows the replacement leg to be installed.
sections.job_setup_note: The aircraft must be on jacks with the gear bay clear and the leg trolley positioned before any pin is removed. The shock absorber must be depressurised through the charging valve, not by breaking a joint. Hydraulic power must be off, the brake accumulator discharged and the system tagged. The leg weighs over 350 kilograms and must never be supported by the trolley alone during pin removal.
sections.procedure: 1. Put the aircraft on jacks and install the ground locks. 2. Remove hydraulic power, discharge the brake accumulator and put the warning notices in the flight compartment. WARNING: THE SHOCK ABSORBER IS CHARGED TO HIGH PRESSURE. DEPRESSURISE IT THROUGH THE CHARGING VALVE ONLY. NEVER BREAK A JOINT TO RELEASE THE PRESSURE. 3. Depressurise the shock absorber and confirm zero pressure at the gauge. 4. Get access to the gear bay through zones 721, 732 and 734. 5. Disconnect the brake pipes, cap them, and disconnect the electrical connectors at the sensor of FIN 1545GM. 6. Disconnect the regulator of FIN 330GB and the pipe of FIN 2002GM and move them clear. 7. Position the leg trolley and take the weight of the leg. CAUTION: THE TROLLEY MUST TAKE THE WEIGHT BEFORE THE FIRST PIN IS WITHDRAWN, BUT IT MUST NOT BE THE ONLY SUPPORT. FIT THE OVERHEAD SLING AS WELL. 8. Remove the side stay pin and then the main pivot pins in the order given in the referenced data. 9. Lower the leg onto the trolley and withdraw it from the bay. 10. Remove the lower torque link clamp WED320317-19 and the vendor clamp CAD561133-34 from the leg and keep them with the aircraft. 11. Cap the open hydraulic ports in the bay and fit the protective covers.
sections.close_out: Fit the protective covers to the pivot bores and to the open hydraulic ports. Record the leg serial number, the hours and cycles and the reason for removal on the component removal card. Leave the aircraft on jacks with the ground locks fitted and make an entry in the technical log that the gear is removed.

safety_precautions: Put the aircraft on jacks and install the ground locks.
Depressurise the shock absorber through the charging valve only.
Discharge the brake accumulator before you disconnect any pipe.
Use both the trolley and the overhead sling to support the leg.

title: Removal of the Main Landing Gear Leg Assembly

issue.reason: Both lower torque link clamps are now listed in the job set-up with an interchangeability note keyed to the sliding tube coating standard.

ata.title: Main Gear — Main Gear Leg Assembly

abstract: Removal of one main landing gear leg assembly with the gear bay supported, covering shock absorber depressurisation, the disconnection sequence, leg handling on the trolley, and the two lower torque link clamps that go with the two sliding tube coating standards.

sections.purpose: This task removes one main landing gear leg assembly from the aircraft so that it can be sent for overhaul or exchanged, and leaves the gear bay in a condition that allows the replacement leg to be installed.
sections.job_setup_note: The aircraft must be on jacks with the gear bay clear and the leg trolley positioned before any pin is removed. The shock absorber must be depressurised through the charging valve, not by breaking a joint. Hydraulic power must be off, the brake accumulator discharged and the system tagged. The leg weighs over 350 kilograms and must never be supported by the trolley alone during pin removal. The lower torque link clamp is not the same part on every leg. Legs whose sliding tube carries the plated running surface take clamp WED320317-19; legs at the sprayed coating standard of MOD-150786 take the thinner clamp D3210114090552. The two are not interchangeable in either direction. Read the coating standard from the leg identification plate before you order a replacement clamp, and enter it on the component removal card.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft; the lower torque link clamp differs with the sliding tube coating standard of MOD-150786
